issues.description: The RW test module enables `exec::utils` without including the required `exec/utils.rs` source file, so the crate cannot build.
issues.rationale: The selected head changes the previously commented declaration to `pub mod utils;`, which makes Rust require `lock-protocol/src/test/rw_version/exec/utils.rs` (or an inline module). That file does not exist in the selected Git tree, and no inline module is present. Reviewer rikosellic explicitly reports that CI/CD fails because this file is missing. The same comment also suggests avoiding redundant copies of the already merged specification utilities, but the independently confirmed build-blocking missing module is the formal root cause. The PR contains only this one commit and was closed without a fix, so the archived head is the exact issue-bearing review revision.
issues.verification: Source-only; historical build/Verus execution was not performed. Confirmed directly from the fixed head that `exec/mod.rs` enables `pub mod utils;` while the required `exec/utils.rs` Git object is absent.
